# PDF Tools & Merger (pdf.gribcov.me)

> Free, secure, client-side web utility for merging, organizing, and manipulating PDF documents directly in the browser.

## Key Features
- Instant PDF merging and page reordering.
- Privacy-first: client-side processing without uploading sensitive documents to external servers.
- Lightweight, responsive interface.
